audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as Job's remembrance of former days: divine intimacy, household abundance, public honor, rescue of poor/orphan/widow, justice as clothing, and respected counsel.

verses.restored: Job again lifted up his discourse and said:

familiar.text: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;

familiar.text: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;

verses.restored: as I was in the days of my autumn/ripeness, when the intimate counsel of the Divine was over my tent,

familiar.text: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;

familiar.text: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;

familiar.text: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;

familiar.text: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!

familiar.text: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.

familiar.text: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

verses.restored: For the ear heard and blessed me, and the eye saw and bore witness for me,

familiar.text: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:

familiar.text: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.

familiar.text: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

familiar.text: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.
